kappa.label: kappa
kappa.role: odd central element of A = V + C K + C kappa; formal first-order parameter of the inhomogeneous deformation (Schema 2)

K.label: K
K.role: even central element; may appear as target label "K" in Schema 2-4 records

central_elements.pbw_position: kappa < [odd] < [even]; K is excluded from the PBW basis

inhomogeneous_deformation.definition: [b_k^s, a_1^sigma] = - gb_{a_1^sigma, b_k^s} * kappa   (kappa odd, central, kappa^2 = 0)
inhomogeneous_deformation.bracket_form: [X,Y]_gamma = [X,Y]_0 + kappa * gamma(X,Y)   (kappa written on the left)

gb_matrix.index_convention: gb_a1{sigma}_b{k}{s} = gb_{a_1^sigma, b_k^s}; sigma = sign of the fermion, s = sign of the boson

inhomogeneous_deformation.gamma_parity_rule: p(gamma(X,Y)) = p(X) + p(Y) + 1 (mod 2); K counts as even
inhomogeneous_deformation.target_space: g + C K  (K = 1: constant terms produced by the deformed bracket)
inhomogeneous_deformation.linearity: gamma is linear homogeneous in the gb parameters (kappa^2 = 0)
